instruction: Set up a Thunderbird filter to add a 'Work' tag to all emails from sender 'boss@company.com'. Configure this locally in Thunderbird only.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a filter to tag emails from a specific sender. The evaluator verifies an enabled filter with 'Add tag' action and 'Work' tag value exists.
metadata.verification: Evaluator checks Thunderbird filter configuration file for expected filter rules with appropriate action and enabled status.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: The evaluator correctly verifies ALL instruction requirements: (1) add 'Work' tag (actionValue='Work'), (2) filter emails from sender 'boss@company.com' (condition=['AND (from,contains,boss@company.com)']), (3) action is 'Add tag', and (4) filter is enabled.

Correct expected rules: The expected.rules.expect entry at line 71-78 includes all necessary fields: enabled='yes', action='Add tag', actionValue='Work', and condition=['AND (from,contains,boss@company.com)'].

Proper metric logic: The metric function check_thunderbird_filter__07f67672 correctly parses the Thunderbird filter configuration file, extracts filter properties including conditions (lines 48-55), and uses _match_record to verify expected filter matches actual filter.

Correct getter usage: Uses get_vm_file to fetch msgFilterRules.dat from the VM at the correct path (/home/user/.thunderbird/t5q2a5hp.default-release/ImapMail/outlook.office365.com/msgFilterRules.dat).
Appropriate postconfig: Includes postconfig to close the 'Message Filters' window before verification, ensuring clean state for file reading.
